text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gasping for breath, Hishi Miracle somehow 
managed to finish the run. Her reward was 
okonomiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Okonomiyaki was Hishi Miracle's favorite 
food. At the same time, it was a symbol of 
happiness. As long as she had modest 
happiness, that was enough...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rushing into big steps wouldn't suit Hishi 
Miracle. We decided to pace her races 
gradually until May of the Classic year.
